idea-plugin.name: Renova
idea-plugin.description:
Assess and migrate legacy Java, .NET and PHP projects from the IDE: Java 8 → 21, Java EE → Jakarta EE, Spring and Spring Boot; .NET Framework and .NET Core → .NET 10; PHP 5 and 7 → PHP 8, Laravel and Symfony. Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, Rider and the other IDEs of the platform.

  • Assess: findings by category, the automation rate, and the plan with who resolves each step; findings appear in the editor and the Problems view.
  • Migrate: a copy of the project is migrated with recipes, rules, guards and, optionally, AI on your own key; the build and tests verify it, and Renova can compare the original and migrated application side by side. The project itself is never changed.

The Renova engine runs inside the IDE. Only AI requests leave the machine, with your own key.
